description: UROC1 pLoF burden in gnomAD v4 and expected biallelic birth prevalence
code:
import requests, pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

q = """query { gene(gene_symbol:"UROC1", reference_genome:GRCh38) {
  variants(dataset: gnomad_r4) { variant_id consequence hgvsc hgvsp flags lof
    genome{ac an homozygote_count} exome{ac an homozygote_count} } } }"""
d = requests.post("https://gnomad.broadinstitute.org/api", json={"query":q}, timeout=180,
                  headers={"Content-Type":"application/json","User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0"}).json()
rows=[]
for v in d["data"]["gene"]["variants"]:
    ac=an=hom=0
    for s in (v.get("exome"), v.get("genome")):
        if s:
            ac += s.get("ac") or 0; an = max(an, s.get("an") or 0); hom += s.get("homozygote_count") or 0
    rows.append(dict(variant_id=v["variant_id"], csq=v["consequence"], hgvsc=v["hgvsc"], hgvsp=v["hgvsp"],
                     lof=v.get("lof"), ac=ac, an=an, hom=hom))
df=pd.DataFrame(rows); df["af"]=df.ac/df.an.replace(0,np.nan)

LOF={"frameshift_variant","stop_gained","splice_acceptor_variant","splice_donor_variant","start_lost","stop_lost"}
plof=df[df.csq.isin(LOF)].copy(); hc=plof[plof.lof=="HC"].copy()
q_all=float(np.nansum(plof.af)); q_hc=float(np.nansum(hc.af))
print("pLoF variants: %d (LOFTEE HC: %d)"%(len(plof),len(hc)))
print("cumulative pLoF AF: all=%.4e  HC=%.4e"%(q_all,q_hc))
print("observed pLoF homozygotes in gnomAD v4:", int(plof.hom.sum()))
for lbl,qq in [("all pLoF",q_all),("LOFTEE HC",q_hc)]:
    print(f"  {lbl}: carriers 1 in {1/(2*qq):,.0f}; biallelic 1 in {1/qq**2:,.0f} births  ({qq**2*1e6:.1f} per million)")

known={"c.1348C>T","c.855G>A","c.541-2A>G","c.1448_1449del","c.1054del","c.209T>C","c.854G>A"}
print("\n--- Reported/ClinVar pathogenic UROC1 variants in gnomAD v4 ---")
print(df[df.hgvsc.isin(known)][["variant_id","hgvsc","hgvsp","csq","ac","an","af","hom"]].to_string(index=False))

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12.5,4.8))
ax=axes[0]
order=["missense_variant","frameshift_variant","stop_gained","splice_donor_variant","splice_acceptor_variant","inframe_deletion"]
cnt=[int((df.csq==c).sum()) for c in order]
cols=["#5b6b7c","#b4553a","#b4553a","#b4553a","#b4553a","#5b6b7c"]
ax.barh([c.replace("_variant","").replace("_"," ") for c in order],cnt,color=cols)
ax.invert_yaxis(); ax.set_xlabel("distinct variants in gnomAD v4 (807,162 individuals)")
ax.set_title("UROC1 coding variation")
for i,c in enumerate(cnt): ax.text(c+12,i,str(c),va="center",fontsize=9)

ax=axes[1]
vals=[q_all**2*1e6, q_hc**2*1e6]
ax.bar(["all pLoF","LOFTEE high-confidence"],vals,color=["#b4553a","#c98a62"],width=0.5)
for i,v in enumerate(vals): ax.text(i,v*1.02,f"{v:.1f}",ha="center")
ax.set_ylabel("expected biallelic pLoF genotypes per million births")
ax.set_title("Predicted recessive UROC1 burden under Hardy-Weinberg\n(fewer than 10 patients reported worldwide since 1971)")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
